ROBLOX – MILLIONS OF GAMES ACROSS EVERY GENRE. PLAY FREE.

Roblox is home to every kind of game, for every kind of player. Compete in high-octane racing games, battle it out in hardcore tactical shooters, or put your survival skills to the test in unpredictable environments. Embark on an epic adventure in immersive RPGs, build massive empires in tycoons, or dive into horror, anime, and sports games with friends worldwide.

Roblox is constantly evolving, with unique experiences and ambitious, high-fidelity games built by a global community including professional studios, indie teams, and solo creators. There’s always something new to discover every day.

Start playing some of the most popular games on Roblox today, including Dress to Impress, RIVALS, Steal a Brainrot, Brookhaven RP, Adopt Me! and more.

WHAT YOU CAN DO ON ROBLOX

PLAY ONLINE MULTIPLAYER GAMES
- Discover deep role-playing games, immersive simulators, action-packed adventures, and more
- Explore trending experiences and new games daily
- Compete in massive multiplayer battles, run your own digital business, or embark on epic quests
- Games may contain optional in-game purchases, including lootboxes and other items

CREATE YOUR OWN AVATAR
- Customize your avatar with detailed clothing, accessories, and dynamic hairstyles
- Discover thousands of user-created 3D avatar items in the Marketplace
- Express yourself with unique emotes, and fashion

CHAT, COMPETE, AND EXPLORE TOGETHER—ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
- Hang out and play with friends in cross-platform multiplayer games on mobile, tablet, PC, console, and VR headsets
- Join a Party and jump into competitive or social experiences together
- Age-verified users can communicate in real-time via voice chat or text

CREATE, PLAY, AND SHARE ON ROBLOX
- Design high-fidelity games and virtual spaces using the Roblox Studio engine on Windows or Mac
- Publish your experiences and empower yourself as a creator in a massive global community
- Dive into immersive 3D multiplayer games and safe, inclusive environments designed for users of all ages
- Enjoy endless new content added daily and share your creations with millions of players

ELEVATE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH ROBLOX PLUS
- Get up to 20% discounts on in-game items, enjoy fee-free Robux transfers, and receive a distinct profile badge
- Host free, unlimited private servers for your friends 
- Publish, trade, and resell your own custom avatar creations on the Marketplace

INDUSTRY-LEADING SAFETY, PRIVACY, AND CIVILITY
- Advanced content filtering and age-appropriate moderation
- Access age-verified spaces and manage your privacy with Roblox Kids and Select Accounts
- Clear community guidelines promoting respectful interactions
- Dedicated trust & safety teams working around the clock

CREATE YOUR OWN GAMES: https://www.roblox.com/develop
SUPPORT: https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us
CONTACT: https://corp.roblox.com/contact/
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.roblox.com/info/privacy
PARENT’S GUIDE: https://corp.roblox.com/parents/
TERMS OF USE: https://en.help.roblox.com/hc/en-us/articles/115004647846

PLEASE NOTE: A network connection is required. Roblox works best over Wi-Fi.

※ Information on App Permissions: Roblox requires the following permissions for your seamless use of the Roblox app.
[Optional Permissions]
Notification: For sending notifications (related to the services, experiences, etc.)
Microphone: For in-game voice chat features
Camera: For animating your avatar with your movement
Contacts: For contact importer features (find other users you may know and make recommendations for friends)
* You can use the app regardless of whether or not you consent to optional permissions
* Certain app features may not work properly if you refuse optional permissions

Enter the world of Block Blast, where every move is a test of your brain and strategy. Dive into the thrill of block crush gameplay—watch vibrant cubes explode in color as you solve each puzzle. With fresh daily puzzle challenges that keep your mind engaged and an endless high score system that rewards your best strategies, Block Blast delivers nonstop excitement for casual players and puzzle masters alike.

Why You'll Love Block Blast
• Daily Puzzle Variety: Every day brings a new puzzle twist, ensuring there’s always something fresh to solve and new rewards to earn.
• Block Puzzle Saga: Match colorful blocks on an 8x8 board and enjoy the satisfying cascade of each block crush.
• Endless High Score Hunt: Push yourself further with each game—break your own records, and climb higher every time you play.
• Casual Yet Challenging: Easy to pick up, but packed with logic-based challenges that sharpen your mind.
• Offline Fun: Play anywhere, anytime—no WiFi required. Perfect for a subway ride or while waiting in the car.

Features of Block Blast
• Strategic Puzzle Gameplay: Drag, place, and match cube blocks on board to trigger chain reactions.
• Adventure Mode: Experience progressive levels with unique jigsaw designs and colorful themes.
• Daily Puzzle Rewards: Stay motivated with special challenges that refresh your brain every day.
• Score Mastery: Compete against friends, share your results, and prove who dominates the endless high score.
• Stunning Block Effects: Feel the rush of every block crush with dynamic visuals and relaxing music effects.

How to Play
• Drag & Match: Place cube blocks on the 8x8 board with precision.
• Crush & Score: Complete rows or columns of tiles and watch the block crush effects cascade.
• Chase Combos: Plan your moves to unlock massive points and extend your endless high score run.
• Stay Strategic: Keep your board clear to make room for bigger plays.

Jump into the Ultimate Block Puzzle Saga!
Ready for mind-sharpening fun? Take on fresh daily puzzles, master the art of the block crush, and see how far you can push your endless high score. Download Block Blast today and start your adventure!

A game of teamwork and betrayal ...in space! Play online with 4-15 players as you attempt to prep your spaceship for departure, but beware as one or more random players among the Crew are Impostors bent on killing everyone.

MASTER YOUR SOCIAL DEDUCTION SKILLS.
Crewmates win by completing all tasks or discovering and voting the Impostors off the ship. The Impostor can use sabotage to cause chaos, making for easier kills and better alibis. Optional roles create a whole new level of gameplay. Try out the Scientist, Engineer, Guardian Angel, or Shapeshifter to create chaos! Think you’re a master of deception? Only one way to find out!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR GAME.
Choose how you want to play! Change the number of Impostors, roles, tasks, player visibility, and more. Play in style as you change your Crewmates’ color, visor, nameplate, outfit, and hat. More customization options are planned to be continually added in.

PLAY WITH ANYONE.
Cross-platform play is supported. Play with friends (or enemies?) between PC, mobile, or console!

If you have any issues, visit us at: https://www.innersloth.com/faq/
